detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

Rooms made with zenplay for the ZX Spectrum screen proportions and colour range, rendered on the Gameboy Advance. ROM compiled using the ual programming language, with the TinyGo compiler target.
The pixel resolution of the Gameboy Advance is 240x160, smaller than the ZX Spectrum, so some tiles are being trimmed.

The mGBA emulator is running the compiled ROM being driven headlessly with gdb, bytes from the GBA's bitmapped display memory are retrieved, and the 15-bit colour image is converted to RGB on the host computer, which then renders a PNG based on RGB data.

Not a real game yet, but this proof  of concept demonstrates that we will be able to target at least two very different platforms in the near future.

Good enough by way of a demo prototype for now!
